def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    face_value = 10000
    coupon_rate = 0.05
    discount_rate = 0.04
    years = 5
    annual_coupon = face_value * coupon_rate
    cash_flows = [annual_coupon] * years

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    pv_coupons = sum(
        cash_flow / ((1 + discount_rate) ** (i + 1))
        for i, cash_flow in enumerate(cash_flows)
    )
    pv_face_value = face_value / ((1 + discount_rate) ** years)
    bond_value = pv_coupons + pv_face_value
    answer = round(bond_value)

    # return answer
    return answer
